total-budget.fcdo:narrative: Collated Planning Budgets: Please note that FCDO’s Official Development Assistance (ODA) budget for the financial years of 2025/26 and 2026/27 has not yet been allocated. In line with the UK Government controls for financial planning, the FCDO can commit up to a proportion of possible future budgets in the financial years beyond this spending review period (ending 2024/25) – this allows the FCDO the flexibility to respond to changing global needs, including humanitarian crises, and fluctuations in future ODA allocations. For these financial years the FCDO has provided figures that are based on an aggregation of current programme planning budgets. This is made up of both approved and pipeline programme plans in 2025/26 and 2026/27, but do not reflect expected allocations. This is shared with the intention of making FCDO’s future spending plans for ODA more accessible and will be updated when ODA allocations are finalised. For the most up to date information on FCDO’s confirmed and indicative budgets for 2023/24 and 2024/25, please see our latest Annual Report and Accounts.

title.narrative: FCDO annual report and accounts 2022 to 2023

description.narrative: The Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) annual report and accounts provides detail on the activities of the FCDO during financial year 2022 to 2023.The report consists of a performance report, an accountability report and financial statements. The financial statements and certain sections of the accountability report are audited by the National Audit Office before they are presented to Parliament. The report was laid in Parliament on 19 July 2022.
